---
name: Bug report / Informe de fallo
about: Something does not work on your phone / Algo no funciona en tu móvil
---

**Mode / Modo:** root (chroot) · no-root (Termux + proot)

**Phone, Android version, ABI / Móvil, versión de Android, ABI:**
(e.g. `getprop ro.product.model`, `getprop ro.build.version.release`, `getprop ro.product.cpu.abi`)

**What happened / Qué pasó:**

**What you expected / Qué esperabas:**

**Diagnostic report / Informe de diagnóstico:**
Send `/diagnostico` to the bot (owner, private chat) and paste the file here, or run
`/opt/bot/venv/bin/python3 /opt/bot/diag.py` inside Debian. It hides the token, IDs, IPs and link
paths, but **read it before posting** and never paste tokens, cookies or `api.txt`.
